invariants.statement: Production code should not construct per-call HttpClient instances on selected release-risk paths.
Repeated health-check JSON response formatting should reuse JsonSerializerOptions.
NodeControl network snapshot aggregation should await tasks instead of reading Task.Result.
DoH requests should preserve cancellation and avoid buffering full responses when stream parsing is sufficient.
Broad LINQ, collection, substring, sealing, and inherited DNS/MDNS sync findings are documented deferrals rather than mechanical rewrites.
